consensus_summary: Spiritual and covenant unfaithfulness to God, most often manifested as idolatry, apostasy, or illicit reliance on foreign worldly powers.
book_summary: Covenant unfaithfulness, specifically joining oneself to other gods or kingdoms outside of the union established by God.
book_core_identification: Covenant unfaithfulness (joining other gods or kingdoms)
boundary_disagreement: None. Both explicitly include spiritual idolatry and improper political alliances as forms of covenant unfaithfulness represented by this imagery.
rationale: The book and the consensus responses are perfectly aligned. Both identify the symbol's primary meaning as covenant unfaithfulness, specifically calling out both religious idolatry ('other gods') and political entanglements ('kingdoms').
